tasks.label: pg15-19-build-test-matrix
args:
set +e
outdir="tests/bench/matrix_20260506"
mkdir -p "$outdir"
summary="$outdir/build_test_summary.txt"
: > "$summary"
declare -A ports=( [15]=5436 [16]=5434 [17]=5435 [18]=5432 [19]=5433 )
for v in 15 16 17 18 19; do
  port="${ports[$v]}"
  pgc="/usr/lib/postgresql/$v/bin/pg_config"
  build_log="$outdir/build_${v}.log"
  test_log="$outdir/test_${v}.log"
  echo "=== PG$v (port $port) ===" | tee -a "$summary"
  if [[ ! -x "$pgc" ]]; then
    echo "PG$v: SKIP (pg_config not found: $pgc)" | tee -a "$summary"
    echo | tee -a "$summary"
    continue
  fi
  sudo -u postgres psql -p "$port" -d postgres -Atqc "SELECT version();" >"$outdir/conn_${v}.log" 2>&1
  conn_rc=$?
  if [[ $conn_rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "PG$v: FAIL connection (see $outdir/conn_${v}.log)" | tee -a "$summary"
    echo | tee -a "$summary"
    continue
  fi
  make clean >"$build_log" 2>&1
  make -j"$(nproc)" all PG_CONFIG="$pgc" >>"$build_log" 2>&1
  build_rc=$?
  if [[ $build_rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "PG$v: FAIL build (see $build_log)" | tee -a "$summary"
    echo | tee -a "$summary"
    continue
  fi
  sudo make install PG_CONFIG="$pgc" >>"$build_log" 2>&1
  install_rc=$?
  if [[ $install_rc -ne 0 ]]; then
    echo "PG$v: FAIL install (see $build_log)" | tee -a "$summary"
    echo | tee -a "$summary"
    continue
  fi
  python3 tests/test_suite.py --port "$port" >"$test_log" 2>&1
  test_rc=$?
  if [[ $test_rc -eq 0 ]]; then
    pass_line=$(grep -E "ALL [0-9]+ TESTS PASSED" "$test_log" | tail -1)
    echo "PG$v: PASS ${pass_line}" | tee -a "$summary"
  else
    fail_line=$(grep -E "[0-9]+ FAILED" "$test_log" | tail -1)
    [[ -z "$fail_line" ]] && fail_line="test suite exited rc=$test_rc"
    echo "PG$v: FAIL ${fail_line}" | tee -a "$summary"
  fi
  echo | tee -a "$summary"
done
cat "$summary"
